items.name: blur-focus
items.title: Blur Focus
items.description: Words sharpen from a soft blur into focus, one after another, as the line enters the screen.

items.name: curved-text
items.title: Curved Text
items.description: Text set around a circle like a stamp or seal, with an optional slow turn.

items.name: decode
items.title: Decode
items.description: A short label resolves from random glyphs, left to right, when it enters the screen or on hover.

items.name: ink-fill
items.title: Ink Fill
items.description: A statement starts in the muted colour and fills with ink word by word as the reader scrolls through it.

items.name: letter-relay
items.title: Letter Relay
items.description: A large hero name shrinks and travels into a fixed header slot letter by letter as you scroll the first screen, so the name hands itself to the navigation.

items.name: neighbour-moves
items.title: Neighbour Moves
items.description: Each letter of a name has its own small move on hover (lift, tilt, stretch, spin, drop), so the word feels like a cast of characters.

items.name: pressure-type
items.title: Pressure Type
items.description: Each letter of one display word stretches wider and heavier as the cursor nears it, like pressing into rubber.

items.name: scroll-float
items.title: Scroll Float
items.description: Letters of a display line rise and settle into place one by one, driven by scroll position, so scrolling back reverses it.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: Split Flap
items.description: Each character flips through the alphabet to its value like a departure board, settling left to right; changing the value flips again.

items.name: width-sprint
items.title: Width Sprint
items.description: A display word stretches wider the faster you scroll and relaxes back when you stop, using the font's width axis.

items.name: ascii-text
items.title: ASCII Text
items.description: A word drawn as a grid of characters, sampled from the word's own letterforms; it settles out of character noise when it enters the screen.

items.name: glitch
items.title: Glitch
items.description: On hover, focus or tap, the word tears for a moment: two offset colour copies slip sideways in thin bands, then it settles. Never loops.

items.name: rotating-words
items.title: Rotating Words
items.description: One word in a sentence turns over to the next, like a rolling counter, a few times, then rests. The slot is as wide as the longest word (with the sentence's ending attached), so nothing around it moves.

items.name: scramble-on-hover
items.title: Scramble on Hover
items.description: Letters near the pointer scramble into other glyphs, like a magnet passing over iron filings, and settle back as it moves on. Unlike Decode, it reacts locally, where the cursor is.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: A single band of light passes once across a short label, like light catching foil or a brass plate, when it enters the screen and again on hover.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: A line types itself out, character by character, when it scrolls into view, with a caret that fades once the line is complete.

items.name: aperture
items.title: Aperture
items.description: The next section opens through a growing circle (an iris) as you scroll into it, from a small porthole to full bleed.

items.name: darkroom-develop
items.title: Darkroom Develop
items.description: A photograph develops from blank paper as it scrolls in: pale and flat first, then contrast, then tone, like a print in the tray.

items.name: horizontal-reel
items.title: Horizontal Reel
items.description: A section pins and vertical scroll pulls a strip of frames sideways, like film through a gate; a frame counter follows.

items.name: reading-rail
items.title: Reading Rail
items.description: A thin rail at the top or edge of the screen fills as you read an article, with an optional chapter label that changes at each heading.

items.name: stacked-deck
items.title: Stacked Deck
items.description: Cards stick one after another and stack like a deck; covered cards step back and dim, leaving their titles as a table of contents.

items.name: thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: One line draws itself down the page as you scroll, linking sections like a seam, a route or a timeline.

items.name: velocity-marquee
items.title: Velocity Marquee
items.description: A looping marquee that drifts on its own, speeds up with scroll speed, follows scroll direction and leans (skews) while you scroll fast.

items.name: image-trail
items.title: Image Trail
items.description: Moving the cursor across an area drops a trail of images that appear, linger briefly and shrink away, cycling through a set.

items.name: lens
items.title: Lens
items.description: A circle follows the cursor and reveals a second layer underneath: sketch under final, night under day, before under after.

items.name: pixel-wake
items.title: Pixel Wake
items.description: The cursor leaves a trail of square pixels on a grid that fade out behind it, like a wake on a low-resolution screen.

items.name: seismograph-line
items.title: Seismograph Line
items.description: A hairline divider bends toward the cursor as it passes and springs back with a small wobble, like a needle on a seismograph.

items.name: target-cursor
items.title: Target Cursor
items.description: A small crosshair follows the cursor; over anything clickable it snaps out into corner brackets that frame the target.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card rotates in 3D toward the cursor with a soft moving highlight, like holding a physical card to the light.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Curtains of northern light hang across a night sky: a sharp lower hem, fading upward in vertical rays, folding slowly. A small WebGL shader draws it; a CSS poster stands in everywhere else.

items.name: beams
items.title: Beams
items.description: Parallel shafts of sunlight fall through a row of high windows (a clerestory, a mill, a stage rig) at one shared angle and sway slightly in depth. CSS 3D only: soft gradient shafts rotated in a perspective space; no WebGL, because transforms are enough here.

items.name: contour-lines
items.title: Contour Lines
items.description: Topographic contour lines drawn as SVG that slowly drift, like a map breathing; deterministic from a seed.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A grid of dots that swell and push away from the cursor, then ease back, like a pin-art board.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: A sphere of evenly spaced dots turns slowly, the far side faint, with a few brighter markers for real places (lat/lon). WebGL points; a CSS dotted disc stands in everywhere else.

items.name: grain
items.title: Grain
items.description: A film-grain layer over a section or the whole page, static by default or gently flickering at a low frame rate.

items.name: halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: Renders an image as print dots on a canvas, sized by brightness, like a newspaper photo; dots can grow in as it enters the screen.

items.name: light-sweep
items.title: Light Sweep
items.description: A slow band of light crosses a surface every few seconds, like sun moving through a window or a scanner pass.

items.name: liquid-field
items.title: Liquid Field
items.description: Slow flowing colour like ink in water or silk in wind, drawn by a tiny WebGL fragment shader with a CSS gradient fallback.

items.name: mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh Gradient
items.description: Four soft pools of colour drift very slowly over a ground colour and blend where they meet, like a dyed silk or a weather map. CSS only: each pool is a radial gradient moved with transform; no blur filter, no WebGL.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Now and then a thin streak of light crosses a night sky at one shared angle and burns out; long quiet gaps between them. CSS only: each streak is a gradient line moved with transform.

items.name: particle-field
items.title: Particle Field
items.description: Dust drifting through a beam of light: soft particles at three depths, the near ones larger and brighter, all moving slowly sideways and bobbing. WebGL points; a CSS poster of scattered motes stands in elsewhere.

items.name: bento-reveal
items.title: Bento Reveal
items.description: A modular grid of mixed-size tiles that enter in reading order with a short stagger the first time the grid scrolls in.

items.name: curve-carousel
items.title: Curve Carousel
items.description: Cards sit on a shallow arc; the focused card is upright and in front, its neighbours tilt and recede. Arrow keys, buttons, drag and swipe move it.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A row of icon buttons that magnify smoothly as the cursor passes along them, neighbours growing a little less.

items.name: flowing-menu
items.title: Flowing Menu
items.description: A big typographic list of links; hovering an item rolls a band over it from the edge the cursor entered, carrying a marquee of the item's words.

items.name: infinite-canvas
items.title: Infinite Canvas
items.description: Drag (or use arrow keys) to pan an endless wall of tiles that repeats in every direction, with a little momentum when you let go.

items.name: sticky-index
items.title: Sticky Index
items.description: A sticky side index lists the page's sections and highlights the one you are reading, with a marker that slides between entries.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Entries arrive one at a time, like orders coming into a kitchen or messages into a log: each slides up into its slot and settles. It plays once, then the list is simply a list.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: Paper pieces burst from a point, tumble and flutter down under gravity and air drag, and are gone in under two seconds. Fired by you, from code, at a real moment.

items.name: device-mockup
items.title: Device Mockup
items.description: A phone, browser or laptop frame drawn in CSS around real content (a screenshot or live markup). For a tall screenshot, pointing at the screen scrolls it slowly to the bottom, like someone reading.

items.name: glare-card
items.title: Glare Card
items.description: A flat, laminated card with a foil sheen: a soft band of colour and a sharp white glint slide across it as the pointer moves, the way a hologram on an ID card or a trading card catches light. The card itself never tilts (for tilt, use Tilt Card).

items.name: glow-border
items.title: Glow Border
items.description: The edge of a card lights up nearest the pointer, as if the pointer were a lamp held close to it; the light fades along the edge with distance. Only the border glows, never the surface.

items.name: icon-cloud
items.title: Icon Cloud
items.description: Labels or small icons sit on the surface of an invisible ball that turns slowly; dragging spins it and it coasts to a stop. The near side is large and sharp, the far side small and faint.

items.name: loader-skeleton
items.title: Loader Skeleton
items.description: Grey placeholder shapes in the exact layout of the content that's coming (an avatar, a title, a few lines), with a faint light passing over them, so the page doesn't jump when the content lands.

items.name: loader-spinner
items.title: Loader Spinner
items.description: A thin ring whose arc stretches and shortens as it turns, for waits of unknown length. It only appears after a short delay, so fast loads never flash a spinner.

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.description: Small badges travel on one or two thin circular orbits around a centre, staying upright as they go; the outer ring turns the other way, more slowly. Pointing at it stops the orbits.

items.name: rainbow-border
items.title: Rainbow Border
items.description: A thin border made of a turning colour wheel around a card or button. It turns while you point at or focus the element and rests otherwise.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A button that a narrow band of light crosses once when you point at it or focus it, and that presses down slightly when clicked.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A dark card with a soft pool of light that follows the pointer across its surface, like a torch on a wall.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A terminal window replays a short session when it scrolls into view: each command types itself after the prompt, its output appears at once, then the next command starts.

items.name: brand-selection
items.title: Brand Selection
items.description: Text selection uses the brand accent and ink instead of the browser's blue, scoped to a section or the whole page.

items.name: click-spark
items.title: Click Spark
items.description: A tiny burst of lines radiates from the click point inside a wrapped area, then disappears.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Confirm
items.description: A copy button whose icon morphs to a tick and whose label says "Copied" for two seconds, then returns.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: A number counts from a start value to its real value once, when it first enters the screen, with tabular figures so it doesn't jitter.

items.name: hold-to-commit
items.title: Hold to Commit
items.description: An important action fills while you press and hold, and only confirms when the fill completes; letting go early drains it back.

items.name: remembered-list
items.title: Remembered List
items.description: A list of links quietly marks the ones you've already opened (a small tick and a lighter weight), remembered across visits on this device.

items.name: squish-switch
items.title: Squish Switch
items.description: A toggle whose knob stretches while pressed and squashes as it lands on the other side, like a soft rubber key.

items.name: sticker-scatter
items.title: Sticker Scatter
items.description: Clicking the logo or name bursts a handful of on-brand stickers (emoji or short glyphs) that fly out, spin, land and fade, like emptying a pocket of stickers.
